QuestInfo.name: Shumi's Forgetfulness
QuestInfo.0: Ask if Shumi would like some help.
QuestInfo.1: Shumi lost her bag in the Subway and wants help finding it. She thinks it was taken by something wearing black clothes. Eliminate #b150 Shades#k in the Subway #r#m103020420##k and retrieve her #bLost Bag#k.
QuestInfo.2: You returned the Lost Bag to Shumi. But how are Shumi and Icarus related? They look nothing like each other!

0.0: Umm... Have YOU seen my bag? I think I lost it in the Subway. I don't suppose you could help a girl in need...?

yes.0: Thank you! I knew my luck had to change!
yes.1: I left my bag on the Subway just before I got off...again. I went back to get it, but these jerks in dark clothes stole it and ran off somewhere.
yes.2: I tried chasing them, but they got away. Think you could hunt those Shades down and get my bag back? They ran off to #r#m103020420##k!

no.0: Please? PRETTY please? Aw, you're no help...

1.0: Yes, that's it! Thanks a ton!

yes.0: I'll never lose it again! I promise!
yes.1: Whew, nice! Now, I don't have to worry about Icarus nagging me. Hmm, don't you know who Icarus is? He's my little bro is Kerning City. I know we don't look alike, but family's family, right? Anyway, he used to be such a sweet little kid, but nowadays he's a real punk.
yes.2: Oh, while you were in the Subway, one of JM's guys came looking for you. It sounded kind of urgent.

item.0: You didn't find my Lost Bag yet? Oh, what am I gonna do? Stupid Shades...
